author: xHeimskr
body:
Hi avicus staff , i will start of a little explanation of me : 

Im an OCN player , never taked avicus seriously thats why I cheated/autoclicked on avicus , now im sorry for that , OCN is dying and I want to create a team on AVICUS , help to make it better and enjoy , enjoy the pvp , enjoy the tourneys , enjoy the server . 

Please im very sorry for that , ocn is dying this server will be the new OCN , so please i just want to be unbanned , thanks !

Sorry if i got some english mistakes . Im spanish. Thanks.
